acceptance_predicates.description: For a catalog larger than the rendered viewport, Up/Down, filtering, kind changes, and resize keep the focused selectable row visible and correctly marked.
Wizard cards use human labels such as Agent and expose no raw formal element identifier such as wizard.agent.
Unavailable catalog rows retain and render their typed actionable reason; an all-unavailable catalog is truthful and does not make a disabled row selectable.
The UI state model, generated artifact, and model/parity checks describe and verify the viewport and availability behavior.
Focused and applicable full checks, independent exact-head review, signed-DCO integration, required CI, merge, and post-merge verification succeed.

definition_of_done: The merged asb-tui wizard has a bounded scrolling catalog viewport, human-facing labels, and reason-preserving unavailable rows with regression coverage.

inputs.description: Current installed asb-tui displays raw wizard.agent, a cursor can leave the eight rendered rows, and unavailable rows lose their catalog reason.
Validated ASB control protocol agent catalog including typed availability reasons.

outputs.description: Reviewed asb-tui renderer/state/model implementation and regression tests.

gates.description: Focused state/render tests cover a catalog beyond the viewport and preserve visible focus.
Typed available and unavailable catalog entries render truthful human-facing states.
Formal-model and UI ownership/parity checks pass.
Independent exact-head review, signed-DCO history, required CI, merge, and post-merge exact-main checks pass.
